mode_comment: dry_run = log intended orders only (no account writes). paper = place real orders on the Alpaca PAPER account.
decision_mode_comment: rules_only = the deterministic stack below (score + half-OR noise band + leader regime + the per-symbol entry rules). llm = that same stack PLUS a bull/bear debate and regime read on top. The LLM only ever REMOVES trades the rules already approved; it can never add one, so rules_only is a strict subset of llm. Flip this flag to swap the two with zero other changes.

score._comment: Entry threshold (0.70) plus the half-opening-range noise band: a candidate must clear the score AND be breaking outside the symbol's own morning noise. Both were fixed against a year of real OPRA option bars rather than tuned to a P&L curve -- see docs/research.md for what that testing kept and what it discarded. Raising min_score above 0.70 was tested and is not an improvement: it trades less without trading better, so the threshold stays where it was calibrated.

entry_rules.dedup_comment: ENTRY-anchored throttle: after a CONFIRMED entry on a symbol+direction, refuse another on that pair for 30 min regardless of whether anything closed. Without it a score that stays above the threshold re-enters the same symbol every scan and stacks up to max_concurrent_positions on one underlying (observed 2026-08-31: IWM put entered at 10:00, 10:05 and 10:10). The exit-anchored cooldown below cannot cover this, because it only arms after a close.
entry_rules.already_holding_comment: There is ALSO an unconditional already-holding guard in risk.py (no config key): never open a second lot on a symbol+direction already held; re-enter only once the held lot has fully closed. It catches exactly what dedup_minutes cannot -- a lot still open after the 30-min throttle has expired (observed 2026-08-31: IWM at 10:37 and again at 11:07). At most one open lot per (symbol, direction) at any time.
entry_rules._comment: Per-symbol entry rules, all of them subtractive. one_direction_per_underlying keeps the book from holding a call and a put on the same underlying at once. The cooldown is SCOPED rather than blanket: it arms only after a time_stop close on that symbol, so a position that timed out is not immediately re-opened while the same conditions persist. Set entry_cooldown_after_exit_reasons to [] for a blanket cooldown after every exit. These bound how often the agent can re-enter one name, independently of what the signal says -- risk hygiene, not signal.

regime._comment: Leader-breadth filter: >=5 of 8 mega-caps above their own 20-DMA as of the last COMPLETED session => bullish, else bearish. Only the OPPOSED side is ever refused -- it never flips a direction and never creates a trade, so it can only remove risk. Computed once per session from completed daily bars only, so it cannot look ahead into the session it is filtering. leader_min_symbols is 8 ON PURPOSE: min_above=5 was calibrated as 5-of-8, so a partial basket would silently become a stricter, bear-biased rule -- full basket or abstain. on_unavailable=abstain means a data failure blocks trading rather than guessing; set it to 'allow' to degrade open instead.

exits._comment: profit_target is a SCALE-OUT: at +40% it sells HALF the opened qty once and leaves a runner (a 1-lot closes outright). The runner is then trailed by giving back runner_giveback_pct (40) of its PEAK GAIN -- measured on the gain, not the price -- which exits as reason runner_trail. premium_stop / time_stop / eod_flatten sell ALL remaining. Set scale_out_at_target=false to revert to a plain full exit at the target. A time_stop exit arms the entry cooldown.
exits.stop_ladder_comment: Downside stop-loss ladder (adopted 2026-09-03): sell HALF of what remains at stop1_loss_pct (-20%), then the REST at stop2_loss_pct (-40%). The half-cut deliberately does NOT mark the remainder a runner, so the surviving half keeps its time stop and profit target. NOTE premium_stop_pct (-65) is UNREACHABLE while this ladder is on: the stop2 branch tests <= -40 and therefore also catches -65 and below. It applies only when stop_ladder_enabled is false. Both exit engines route through Executor._stop_ladder_exit.

risk.max_trades_per_day_comment: 0 = NO daily entry-count cap. Turnover is bounded by max_alerts_per_run (per scan) + dedup + the already-holding guard, not by a daily count. max_concurrent_positions stays at 3 as defense in depth: it is already structurally guaranteed (3 symbols x one open lot per symbol+direction, via the already-holding guard and one_direction_per_underlying), so it never binds in normal operation -- but it stops runaway stacking at size if the in-memory book ever drifts. Set >0 to re-arm a hard daily stop.
risk._comment: ADAPTIVE sizing: contracts_per_trade (300) is the TARGET, and the size is trimmed to fit both max_premium_per_trade_usd and the remaining max_open_premium_usd room. THE ACCOUNT IS THE SOLE BINDING LIMITER: max_premium_per_trade_usd (350000) only bites above ~$11.67 a contract at 300 lots, far above any ATM 0DTE premium, so it never binds before the account does. max_open_premium_usd (95000) is further capped at runtime by min(95000, the account's REAL options buying power), so on a ~$100k paper account the aggregate ceiling is ~$95k. At 300 lots that ceiling binds for any contract above ~$3.17 (95000/(3.17*100)=300): a full 300-lot therefore opens only on cheap contracts (a $0.50 IWM put -> 300 lots = $15k) and a pricier one trims to fit (a $5.86 contract -> ~162 lots). Later concurrent entries trim to whatever room is left. Single-leg LONG only => the maximum loss per trade is the premium paid. Entries use a marketable limit (ask + entry_limit_slippage_pct%) to bound slippage at size. flatten_foreign_at_startup dumps any option position the agent did not open (orphan guard).

scan.manage_step_minutes_comment: How often OPEN POSITIONS are re-checked, in minutes. Entries stay on scan_step_minutes; only the exit ladder runs at this faster cadence, priced off Alpaca option quotes, so the extra passes add no yfinance load. Clamped into [1, scan_step_minutes]. At 5 minutes a 0DTE contract can cross the whole -20/-40 ladder between two looks and exit only at the deeper rung; 1 minute narrows that window.
scan.max_alerts_per_run_comment: Per-SCAN entry cap: at most this many NEW entries may open in a single scan pass, across all symbols; the rest are skipped that pass and reconsidered on the next one. 0 disables it. This is a per-run throttle, NOT a per-day total.

llm._comment: Only used when decision_mode = llm. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. If the key is missing the gate degrades to rules_only and says so in the log.
